newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close lower at 21.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close lower at 21.25 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates slipped further on Tuesday due to the combined effects of the upcoming end-of month reserve period deadline and the central bank's Monday repo rate cuts, traders said.
O/N rates closed at 21.25 percent, down 0.25 percentage points from Monday's close.
"We might see overnight rates ease further in the next days," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) cut four of its five repo rates by 0.25 percentage points each on Monday.
The NBH cut both the overnight and one-week repo rates to 28.5 percent, the one-week reverse repo rate was lowered to 22.5 percent, while its one-month reverse repo rate to 23.0 percent.
The overnight reverse repo remained unchanged at 17.50 percent.
